name: Big
source:
The previous leader of Zokibayashi All-Boys School. He's still a proud and fearless delinquent who values manliness and honour above all.

[Spoiler]He gave up his position as leader after miraculously losing in a one-on-one hand-to-hand duel against [url=/c98113]Saruyoshi[/url].[/spoiler]
